Harold learned to use the camera the way other comics used a bowler hat or a funny walk...

Keaton was recognized as the seventh-greatest director of all time by Entertainment Weekly.  In 1999, the American Film Institute ranked Keaton the 21st-greatest male star of all time...
rows.d.name: Buster Keaton

m.plot: A friendship between two young men is tested when they go for a hike in a desert and forget to bring any water or food with them.
m.title: Gerry

m.title: Spanish Apartment, The (L'auberge espagnole)

m.plot: Cultural mistrust and false accusations doom a friendship in British colonial India between an Indian doctor, an Englishwoman engaged to marry a city magistrate, and an English educator.
m.title: Passage to India, A

m.plot: A young American studying in Paris in 1968 strikes up a friendship with a French brother and sister. Set against the background of the '68 Paris student riots.
m.title: Dreamers, The

m.plot: Headbangers Terry and Dean explore the depths of friendship, and the art and science of drinking beer like a man.
m.title: Fubar

m.plot: A close friendship between two crew teammates is tested when one slowly discovers he's gay and attracted to the other.
m.title: Summer Storm (Sommersturm)

m.plot: All but abandoned by her family in a London retirement hotel, an elderly woman strikes up a curious friendship with a young writer.
m.title: Mrs. Palfrey at the Claremont

m.plot: An inner-city junior high school teacher with a drug habit forms an unlikely friendship with one of his students after she discovers his secret.
m.title: Half Nelson

m.plot: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new friend also go well beyond platonic friendship.
m.title: Notes on a Scandal

m.plot: Set during World War II, a story seen through the innocent eyes of Bruno, the eight-year-old son of the commandant at a concentration camp, whose forbidden friendship with a Jewish boy on the other side of the camp fence has startling and unexpected consequences.
m.title: Boy in the Striped Pajamas, The (Boy in the Striped Pyjamas, The)

m.plot: A tale of friendship between two unlikely pen pals: Mary, a lonely, eight-year-old girl living in the suburbs of Melbourne, and Max, a forty-four-year old, severely obese man living in New York.
m.title: Mary and Max

m.plot: Young filmmakers document their colleague's budding online friendship with a young woman and her family which leads to an unexpected series of discoveries.
m.title: Catfish

m.plot: In small-town Texas, an affable mortician strikes up a friendship with a wealthy widow, though when she starts to become controlling, he goes to great lengths to separate himself from her grasp.
m.title: Bernie

m.plot: The lives of two mob hit men, a boxer, a gangster's wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.
m.title: Pulp Fiction

m.plot: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.
m.title: Shawshank Redemption, The

m.plot: Forrest Gump, while not intelligent, has accidentally been present at many historic moments, but his true love, Jenny Curran, eludes him.

m.plot: Lion cub and future king Simba searches for his identity. His eagerness to please others and penchant for testing his boundaries sometimes gets him into trouble.
m.title: Lion King, The

m.plot: In Poland during World War II, Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.
m.title: Schindler's List

m.plot: A cyborg, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her young son, John Connor, from a more advanced cyborg, made out of liquid metal.
m.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

m.plot: A young F.B.I. cadet must confide in an incarcerated and manipulative killer to receive his help on catching another serial killer who skins his victims.
m.title: Silence of the Lambs, The

m.plot: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.
m.title: Godfather, The

m.plot: After a simple jewelery heist goes terribly wrong, the surviving criminals begin to suspect that one of them is a police informant.
m.title: Reservoir Dogs

m.plot: A criminal pleads insanity after getting into trouble again and once in the mental institution rebels against the oppressive nurse and rallies up the scared patients.
m.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest

m.plot: After the rebels have been brutally overpowered by the Empire on their newly established base, Luke Skywalker takes advanced Jedi training with Master Yoda, while his friends are pursued by Darth Vader as part of his plan to capture Luke.
m.title: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back

m.plot: Archaeologist and adventurer Indiana Jones is hired by the US government to find the Ark of the Covenant before the Nazis.
m.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark (Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark)

m.plot: After rescuing Han Solo from the palace of Jabba the Hutt, the rebels attempt to destroy the second Death Star, while Luke struggles to make Vader return from the dark side of the Force.
m.title: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi

m.plot: Henry Hill and his friends work their way up through the mob hierarchy.
m.title: Goodfellas

m.plot: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York is portrayed while his son, Michael, expands and tightens his grip on his crime syndicate stretching from Lake Tahoe, Nevada to pre-revolution 1958 Cuba.
m.title: Godfather: Part II, The

m.plot: A young man is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his friend, Dr. Emmett Brown, and must make sure his high-school-age parents unite in order to save his own existence.
m.title: Back to the Future

m.plot: An insurance salesman/adjuster discovers his entire life is actually a T.V. show.
m.title: Truman Show, The

m.plot: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind, but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.
m.title: Titanic

m.plot: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.
m.title: Saving Private Ryan

m.plot: A former neo-nazi skinhead tries to prevent his younger brother from going down the same wrong path that he did.
m.title: American History X

m.plot: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.
m.title: Matrix, The

m.plot: A boy who communicates with spirits that don't know they're dead seeks the help of a disheartened child psychologist.
m.title: Sixth Sense, The

m.plot: A bored suburban father has a mid-life crisis after becoming infatuated with his daughter's best friend.
m.title: American Beauty

m.plot: An insomniac office worker, looking for a way to change his life, crosses paths with a devil-may-care soap maker, forming an underground fight club that evolves into something much, much more...
m.title: Fight Club

m.plot: The lives of guards on Death Row are affected by one of their charges: a black man accused of child murder and rape, yet who has a mysterious gift.
m.title: Green Mile, The

m.plot: When a Roman general is betrayed and his family murdered by an emperor's corrupt son, he comes to Rome as a gladiator to seek revenge.
m.title: Gladiator

m.plot: A man creates a strange system to help him remember things; so he can hunt for the murderer of his wife without his short-term memory loss being an obstacle.
m.title: Memento

m.plot: A meek Hobbit and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the One Ring and the Dark Lord Sauron.
m.title: Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring, The

m.plot: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.
m.title: Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers, The

m.plot: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.
m.title: Finding Nemo

m.plot: Blacksmith Will Turner teams up with eccentric pirate Captain Jack Sparrow to save his love, the governor's daughter, from Jack's former pirate allies, who are now undead.
m.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

m.plot: The Bride wakens from a four-year coma. The child she carried in her womb is gone. Now she must wreak vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her - a team she was once part of.
m.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1

m.plot: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.
m.title: Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King, The

m.plot: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a procedure to have each other erased from their memories. But it is only through the process of loss that they discover what they had to begin with.
m.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

m.plot: A film that explores the dark and miserable town, Basin City, and tells the story of three different people, all caught up in violent corruption.
m.title: Sin City

m.plot: After training with his mentor, Batman begins his war on crime to free the crime-ridden Gotham City from corruption that the Scarecrow and the League of Shadows have cast upon it.
m.title: Batman Begins

m.plot: In a future British tyranny, a shadowy freedom fighter, known only by the alias of V, plots to overthrow it with the help of a young woman.
m.title: V for Vendetta

m.plot: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.
m.title: Departed, The

m.plot: Two stage magicians engage in competitive one-upmanship in an attempt to create the ultimate stage illusion.
m.title: Prestige, The

m.plot: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, the caped crusader must come to terms with one of the greatest psychological tests of his ability to fight injustice.
m.title: Dark Knight, The

m.plot: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, an engineer creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.
m.title: Iron Man

m.plot: In the distant future, a small waste-collecting robot inadvertently embarks on a space journey that will ultimately decide the fate of mankind.
m.title: WALL·E

m.plot: A Mumbai teen reflects on his upbringing in the slums when he is accused of cheating on the Indian Version of Who Wants to be a Millionaire?
m.title: Slumdog Millionaire

m.plot: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans for the same.
m.title: Inglourious Basterds

m.plot: Seventy-eight year old Carl Fredricksen travels to Paradise Falls in his home equipped with balloons, inadvertently taking a young stowaway.
m.title: Up

m.plot: A paraplegic marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.
m.title: Avatar

m.plot: A U.S Marshal investigates the disappearance of a murderess who escaped from a hospital for the criminally insane.
m.title: Shutter Island

m.plot: A thief, who steals corporate secrets through use of dream-sharing technology, is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO.
m.title: Inception

m.plot: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.
m.title: Avengers, The

m.plot: Katniss Everdeen voluntarily takes her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games, a televised competition in which two teenagers from each of the twelve Districts of Panem are chosen at random to fight to the death.
m.title: The Hunger Games

m.plot: Eight years after the Joker's reign of anarchy, the Dark Knight, with the help of the enigmatic Selina, is forced from his imposed exile to save Gotham City, now on the edge of total annihilation, from the brutal guerrilla terrorist Bane.
m.title: Dark Knight Rises, The

m.plot: A reluctant hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home - and the gold within it - from the dragon Smaug.
m.title: Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey, The

m.plot: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
m.title: Django Unchained

m.plot: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.
m.title: Wolf of Wall Street, The

m.plot: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.
m.title: Interstellar

m.plot: A group of intergalactic criminals are forced to work together to stop a fanatical warrior from taking control of the universe.
m.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
